I kept this as one `company-handbook` skill, but I did not paste all 3,000 lines into SKILL.md or use "Use for anything related to our company." That description gives Claude no trigger, and the body would almost certainly exceed the validator's size cap. Every session would also load all 3,000 lines, including phone numbers and PTO policy, even for an unrelated task.

You still get one skill and one folder to maintain. SKILL.md is a short router, and the content moves into `references/` files that load only when needed.

## SKILL.md

```markdown
---
name: company-handbook
description: Invoke when a task touches company-specific rules or facts: code style, deploys and rollbacks, on-call alerts, PTO and expenses, brand voice, org contacts, or internal terms. Read the matching reference file before answering.
---

# Company Handbook

## Contents

- [Routing](#routing)
- [Rules](#rules)

## Routing

Read only the file that matches the task.

| Task | Read |
|------|------|
| Writing or reviewing Python or TypeScript | [code-style.md](references/code-style.md) |
| Deploying or rolling back any of the 4 services | [deploy.md](references/deploy.md) |
| Responding to an alert or incident | [oncall-runbook.md](references/oncall-runbook.md) |
| PTO, expenses, reimbursement questions | [pto-expenses.md](references/pto-expenses.md) |
| Writing marketing copy | [brand-voice.md](references/brand-voice.md) |
| Who owns something, who to contact | [org-chart.md](references/org-chart.md) |
| Unfamiliar internal term or acronym | [glossary.md](references/glossary.md) |

## Rules

- Quote the reference file rather than answering from memory.
- If the files do not cover the question, say so instead of guessing.
- Share names and phone numbers only when the user's task needs them.
```

## references/ layout

| File | Source content | Notes |
|------|----------------|-------|
| `code-style.md` | ~600 lines | Add a ToC with Python and TypeScript sections. |
| `deploy.md` | ~400 lines | One section per service, each with its rollback steps. |
| `oncall-runbook.md` | ~900 lines | Add a ToC listing all 35 alerts. Consider splitting by alert family if it grows. |
| `pto-expenses.md` | ~300 lines | PTO and expenses as two sections. |
| `brand-voice.md` | ~250 lines | |
| `org-chart.md` | ~200 lines | Only loads on demand. Consider whether phone numbers belong in a skill file at all, since it may be shared or packaged. |
| `glossary.md` | ~350 lines | Alphabetical. |

## Next steps

1. Split the existing content into the files above, with no rewriting needed.
2. Run `python3 scripts/validate.py company-handbook`.
3. Draft 3+ evals before relying on it, for example "roll back service X", "what does alert Y mean", and "write a landing page blurb".

If the lead wants this done today, the split is mostly copy and paste. The routing table is the only new writing.
